# WordPress Studio

> WordPress Studio is a free, open source AI website builder and local WordPress development environment, as an app and a CLI. It runs real WordPress on macOS, Windows and Linux with native PHP and SQLite, with no Docker. AI agents build and edit sites through Studio Code, the built-in agent, or through plugins and an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor and Grok Build. Studio Code runs on a ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot plan, an API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or Meta, or WordPress.com AI credits.

## Get started

- [Download](https://wordpress.studio/download/): Get the app, the CLI and Studio Code for macOS, Windows or Linux.
- [App](https://wordpress.studio/app/): All your local WordPress sites in one window, with Studio Code built in.
- [CLI](https://wordpress.studio/cli/): Create local sites, run WP-CLI, share previews and push live from the terminal, in scripts or in CI.

## WordPress and AI agents

- [Agents](https://wordpress.studio/agents/): Give your agent WordPress tools through plugins and an MCP server.
- [Claude Code](https://wordpress.studio/agents/claude-code/): Set up the Studio plugin for Claude Code.
- [ChatGPT and Codex](https://wordpress.studio/agents/codex/): Install WordPress Studio from Codex's plugin directory, in the ChatGPT app or the Codex CLI: `codex plugin add wp-studio@openai-curated-remote`.
- [WordPress Studio in the Codex plugin directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6ad3ad9e33f48191b7ee5f08bf3b6e7e): The plugin's page, for Codex and the ChatGPT app.
- [Cursor](https://wordpress.studio/agents/cursor/): Install the Studio plugin for Cursor, or add Studio to Cursor's MCP servers.
- [Grok Build](https://wordpress.studio/agents/#grok-build): Install the Studio plugin for Grok Build.
- [AI providers](https://wordpress.studio/docs/providers/): Run Studio Code on a ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot plan, your own API key, or WordPress.com AI credits.

## Moving and publishing sites

- [Liberate](https://wordpress.studio/liberate/): Bring a backup, a live WordPress site or any URL into a local WordPress site.
- [Ship](https://wordpress.studio/ship/): Share a preview, publish to WordPress.com, Pressable or Spacefast, and pull live changes back down.

## Decide

- [Pricing](https://wordpress.studio/pricing/): The app, the CLI and local sites are free. AI is the only part with a meter.
- [Studio vs Local](https://wordpress.studio/compare/): How Studio compares with Local (LocalWP).

## Reference

- [Documentation](https://wordpress.studio/docs/): Full Studio documentation. Every page has a Markdown copy, e.g. https://wordpress.studio/docs/cli.md, and https://wordpress.studio/docs/llms.txt lists them.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Automattic/studio): The open source repository, under GPLv2 or later.
